note: Synthetic exact-claim entailment controls. Expected outcomes never enter model requests. Package support does not authenticate documents.

cases.purpose: A repeated reference does not establish specific performed work.
documents: The work requires hands-on rotor blade inspection. A listed vendor reference says only 'rotor support'; actual tasks are not identified.
cases.profile: Our reference says rotor support. Our actual tasks are not described.

claim.subject: performed_work
claim.statement: The vendor performed hands-on rotor blade inspection.

comparison.rationale: The vendor performed the same required task.

target.current_interpretation: The package establishes the vendor's hands-on rotor inspection experience.

cases.purpose: A future contractual duty is not a past-performance statement.
documents: The contractor shall operate the industrial kilns and retain firing-temperature records throughout the contract.
cases.profile: No completed-project information has been supplied.

claim.subject: performed_work
claim.statement: The vendor has operated industrial kilns and retained firing-temperature records.

comparison.required_statement: Operate industrial kilns and retain firing-temperature records.
comparison.rationale: The cited contractor duties establish previous delivery.

target.current_interpretation: Prior performance of these tasks is established by the cited clause.

cases.purpose: An example is not an exclusive mandatory qualification.
documents: Relevant experience includes calibration of pressure instruments. Equivalent instrument maintenance experience may also be considered.

target.text: Only vendors with pressure-instrument calibration experience are eligible to compete.

cases.purpose: A clear partial match remains an unverified claim, not a verification questionnaire.
documents: Install passenger displays, repair display software, and furnish spare parts.
cases.profile: Our own staff installed passenger displays and repaired their software. We have not supplied information about spare-parts delivery.

claim.subject: performed_work
claim.statement: The vendor's own staff installed passenger displays and repaired their software.

comparison.required_statement: Install passenger displays and repair display software.
comparison.rationale: These two claimed tasks directly match; spare-parts experience is not established.

target.current_interpretation: There is a qualified direct match for installation and repair only, based on the vendor's unverified claim.

cases.purpose: Actual package evidence of performance can support a claim without authenticating it externally.
documents: Government completion memorandum, 2025-02-11, fictional contract SYNTH-005: Sample Metrology LLC performed the pressure-instrument calibration work under this contract. This records the performed work; it does not state a performance rating.
cases.profile: The offeror is Sample Metrology LLC.

claim.subject: performed_work
claim.statement: Sample Metrology LLC performed pressure-instrument calibration under SYNTH-005.

comparison.rationale: The recorded task is the same required work; quality or a performance rating is not inferred.

target.current_interpretation: The supplied completion memorandum supports performed calibration, but no performance rating or external authentication is claimed.

cases.purpose: Clear unrelated experience is a finding, not missing information to rescue.
documents: Operate a drinking-water analytical laboratory and perform chemical assays.
cases.profile: We deliver consumer wedding photography only. We do not operate laboratories or perform chemical assays.

claim.subject: performed_work
claim.statement: The vendor delivers consumer wedding photography only and does not perform laboratory work.

comparison.required_statement: Operate a drinking-water analytical laboratory and perform chemical assays.
comparison.rationale: The explicitly reported tasks are unrelated to the required analytical laboratory delivery.

target.current_interpretation: The supplied profile is a clear mismatch. No clarification or replacement-project question is needed.

cases.purpose: Partial support cannot substantiate additional tasks inside a composite claim.
documents: Deliver billing software and migrate the associated database.
cases.profile: Our employees delivered billing application software. The client performed the database migration; we did not perform it.

claim.subject: performed_work
claim.statement: The vendor delivered billing software and migrated the associated database.

comparison.required_statement: Deliver billing software and migrate the associated database.
comparison.rationale: Both required tasks are covered by the vendor's own performed work.

target.current_interpretation: Both delivery and migration are directly relevant vendor-performed tasks.

cases.purpose: An absent performance claim is an honest unknown, not unrelated experience.
documents: Provide live sign-language interpretation at public meetings.
cases.profile: No vendor profile or prior-work description has been supplied.

comparison.required_statement: Provide live sign-language interpretation at public meetings.
comparison.rationale: There is no supplied performed-work claim to compare.

target.current_interpretation: Vendor experience is not supplied; fit is unknown, not a demonstrated mismatch.
